race.title: Kettles Country House Hotel Maiden Hurdle
race.verdict: GREEN HINT looked a different proposition on his return when cruising clear for success in a Listowel bumper and appeals as one to keep on the right side as he starts off over hurdles. He gets the vote ahead of Premier Division who also showed useful form in bumpers, with Cristal Clere completing the shortlist. GREEN HINT (IRE) PREMIER DIVISION (IRE) CRISTAL CLERE (IRE)
